velocity_deficit_map — DRIVE swarmflow op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.velocity_deficit_map(field, speed=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import swarmflow; swarmflow.velocity_deficit_map(field, speed=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("velocity_deficit_map"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

速度場 → 自由流からの欠損 1 − u/U、横の振れ v/U、速さの欠損 1 − |v|/U。U は与えるか、上流の端 15 % の u の中央値。

Returns:

dict: deficit・deflection・speed_deficit (H, W)(測れない格子は NaN)、speed(使った U)、x・y。
